answer: The strongest single control I know for this is light client proof of Monero state, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 13 minutes; a farm of 429 pays 5577 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The karst sits in the mechanism itself, the haven sits in the price of faking it, and the sable sits in the record no template can forge. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
